TermTranslation.definition: An operation to remove part or all of the colon.

TermTranslation.term: chiki minishikiniu anit-h mikw kâ mâyâtihch chitichishî âkw mîn kâu châ ânischâmuhtâkiniwich
TermTranslation.term_syllabics: ᒋᑭ ᒥᓂᔑᑭᓂᐤ ᐊᓂᑦᐦ ᒥᒄ ᑳ ᒫᔮᑎᐦᒡ ᒋᑎᒋᔒ ᐋᒄ ᒦᓐ ᑳᐤ ᒑ ᐋᓂᔅᒑᒧᐦᑖᑭᓂᐎᒡ
TermTranslation.public_note_en: the bad part of the colon will be cut off and it’ll be reconnected again

TermTranslation.term: chika minishikanû anit mikw kâ mâyâtihch chitachishî ekw mîn kâu che ânischemuhtâkanuwihch
TermTranslation.term_syllabics: ᒋᑲ ᒥᓂᔑᑲᓅ ᐊᓂᑦ ᒥᒄ ᑳ ᒫᔮᑎᐦᒡ ᒋᑕᒋᔒ ᐁᒄ ᒦᓐ ᑳᐤ ᒉ ᐋᓂᔅᒉᒧᐦᑖᑲᓄᐎᐦᒡ
TermTranslation.public_note_en: the bad part of the colon will be cut off and it’ll be reconnected again
